name: ina-platform-api
description: Dependencies for the Vercel serverless functions under api/, and for local-server.js — an optional, fully local way to run the same site + AI endpoints on your own machine (no Vercel involved) against a local model via Ollama. The static site itself (index.html, app/, assets/) needs no build step either way. See 'Running everything locally, without Vercel' in PLATFORM_SETUP.md.
